profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer I at Avery
profile.summary: My name is Giovanni S. Martinez. I am a software engineer at Avery. I have a passion for being challenged by concepts that have never been implemented or attempted, and to provide good quality code. I love programming and learning new things in the field. My skills in the tech industry vary from object-oriented programming, database management (sql or nosql), little knowledge of systems admin, quality assurance testing/smoke checking, and being an overall team player by providing input into software designs. I am currently working with nodejs with locomotive.js as a web framework. I'm also familiar with SCRUM development, using Jira. I believe that I bring a positive energy to the work environment and don't take offense to criticism on quality of code because I see it as an opportunity to improve my skills.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: My main role is as a full-stack software engineer. I initially worked on the website redesign project, using the latest Angular technology.  I've developed and maintained customer configuration tools such as Avery WePrint. Worked with different project managers and content managers, in order to help them configure the website more easily. Took lead in the initial development of the Amazon Transparency project. This allowed small retail business owners to purchase our labels that integrated with Amazon's technology, for preventing the sale of counterfeit products.

positions.title: Teacher Assistant
positions.description: Worked at a coding bootcamp, as a teacher's assistant. I helped students learn the full stack web development. Tech stack included, jQuery, Mysql, nodejs, expressjs, reactjs, and mongodb. Also helped the lecturer move the class along with the lectures, and assisted with analyzing and grading code.

projects.title: Sphero Knockout!
projects.description: Sphero Knockout! is an Android game that allows users to battle it out using Sphero devices.
